entities.summary: Ilya Igorevich Zubov is a Russian professional ice hockey player currently playing for Hc Tesla Orli Znojmo of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He played two seasons in the American Hockey League (AHL) for the Binghamton Senators and ten games in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Ottawa Senators.
